{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 331''' was one of many [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] in [[Karfeddion Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> prior to the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Arwen Cohl|Cohl]], [[Boiny]], and [[Lope (individual)|Lope]] rendezvoused with several [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] members in the bay before embarking on their attempted assassination mission of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="CoD" />
